scripts.copy-assets: shx cp -r src/images-videos public/dist && shx cp -r src/audio public/dist
scripts.watch: parcel watch src/js/*.js src/styles/scss/main.scss src/styles/components.scss src/styles/driver-dashboard.scss src/styles/status-board.scss src/styles/profile.scss src/styles/jobsview.scss src/styles/register.scss src/styles/style.scss src/styles/tsheet.scss src/styles/messages.scss --dist-dir public/dist --no-hmr
scripts.dev: npm run copy-assets && concurrently "npm run watch" "npm run serve"
scripts.build: parcel build src/js/*.js src/styles/scss/main.scss src/styles/components.scss src/styles/driver-dashboard.scss src/styles/status-board.scss src/styles/profile.scss src/styles/jobsview.scss src/styles/register.scss src/styles/style.scss src/styles/tsheet.scss src/styles/messages.scss --dist-dir public/dist --no-scope-hoist && shx cp -r src/images-videos public/dist && shx cp -r src/audio public/dist
